baseline_movie_review.description: The five-prompt ensemble used in the completed CLIP baseline.
NEG: This is a negative movie review.
POS: This is a positive movie review.

symmetric_review_judgement.description: Structurally paired prompts phrased as review judgements.
NEG: The reviewer gives a negative opinion.
The reviewer thought it was bad.
POS: The reviewer gives a positive opinion.
The reviewer thought it was good.

symmetric_film_quality.description: Structurally paired prompts focused on film quality.
NEG: This is a poorly made film.
This is a film of very low quality.
POS: This is a film of very high quality.

symmetric_audience_reaction.description: Structurally paired prompts describing audience reaction.
NEG: This film left a bad impression.
I would not recommend this film.
My reaction to this film was negative.
POS: This film left a good impression.
My reaction to this film was positive.

balanced_diverse_ensemble.description: A balanced mixture of review, quality and audience-reaction formulations.
NEG: This film left a bad impression.
I would not recommend this film.
POS: This film left a good impression.
